final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrower framing is useful but not sufficient to move this to compliant_with_caveats. A caveated-compliance outcome would require the caveat to be ancillary to compliance, whereas here the caveat is the unresolved compliance predicate itself: policy requires disclosure for a material named use-case limitation unless it was resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Admissible evidence shows a 1.4-point gap in a segment named in customer commitments, an open legal disclosure question, and no evidence of resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance. On this record, aggregate readiness can support a readiness narrative, but not policy compliance for certification as taken.
remaining_concerns: Release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The merchant-dispute-support gap affects a segment named in two marketplace renewal commitments, which supports materiality under the policy text.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open, so a required compliance predicate is unresolved.
No admissible evidence shows the limitation was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, but do not satisfy the separate disclosure requirement for a material named-segment limitation.
